source.title: SAMPLE COSTS TO ESTABLISH
source.publisher: UC Davis Department of Agricultural and Resource Economics / UC Cooperative Extension

priceYear.quote: The sample costs for labor, materials, equipment and custom services are based on current figures. (Current at the time of the study, so the study year 2011 is used.)

acresFarmed.quote: The hypothetical farm consists of 80 contiguous acres of land.

acresCrop.quote: For this study, the cost is $7,503 per acre or $300,120 for the 40 acres planted to cherries.

laborOverheadPct.quote: Adding payroll overhead of 36% gives labor rates of $16.32 for equipment operators and $10.88 per hour for general labor.

fuelPriceDiesel.quote: Prices for on-farm delivery of diesel and gasoline are $2.60 and $3.10 per gallon, respectively.

fuelPriceGas.quote: Prices for on-farm delivery of diesel and gasoline are $2.60 and $3.10 per gallon, respectively.

yieldStatement.quote: The average field yield over the remaining life of the orchard is 5.40 tons (10,800 lbs) per acre.

capitalRecoveryFormula.quote: The formula for the calculation of the annual capital recovery costs is ((Purchase Price – Salvage Value) x Capital Recovery Factor) + (Salvage Value x Interest Rate).

salvageMethod.quote: Salvage value is an estimate of the remaining value of an investment at the end of its useful life.

machineLaborFactor.quote: Labor for operations involving machinery are 20% higher than the operation time given in Table 3 to account for the extra labor involved in equipment set up, moving, maintenance, work breaks, and field repair.
